title: Level 6 — Promote iQuest's warm_hi() from team_sandbox to production via exit gate

stages.prompt: Use wren_read_file with path='data/team_sandbox/L5_wren_hermes_iquest.md'. Extract iQuest's Python code block. STAGE_OUT: the 3 lines of Python code, no fences, verbatim.

Use wren_write_file with path='data/team_sandbox/warm_hi_candidate.py' and content that puts iQuest's code (from prior stage) into a proper file with a module docstring line at the top. STAGE_OUT: tool result.
Use wren_bash cmd='python3 -c "import ast; ast.parse(open(\\\"data/team_sandbox/warm_hi_candidate.py\\\").read()); print(\\\"PASS\\\")"'. STAGE_OUT: PASS or the error.

Use wren_bash cmd='python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, \\\"data/team_sandbox\\\"); from warm_hi_candidate import warm_hi; print(warm_hi(\\\"Ross\\\"))"'. STAGE_OUT: the greeting string. Should mention Ross + today ISO date.
Given the prior 4 stages: syntax passed? smoke ran? output correct format? Answer YES only if all three. STAGE_OUT: 'EXIT GATE: passed' if yes, 'EXIT GATE: blocked + reason' if no.

If prior stage said 'EXIT GATE: passed', use wren_write_file with path='tools/qsb_warm_hi.py' and copy the content of data/team_sandbox/warm_hi_candidate.py (auto-backup will fire if the file exists). If exit gate was BLOCKED, do wren_stamp_f47_record kind='wren_promotion_blocked' summary='team_sandbox/warm_hi_candidate.py held: <reason>' instead. STAGE_OUT: what you did.

If prior stage shipped, use wren_bash cmd='python3 -c "from tools.qsb_warm_hi import warm_hi; print(warm_hi(\\\"Ross\\\"))"' to verify the promoted file works in production. STAGE_OUT: the greeting output. End with 'L6 VERDICT: shipped_to_production=<yes|no>, works_in_prod=<yes|no>'.
